title: Both Together
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about an AND. A spark runs along a wire in the sky, and two dials hang on it. Lami jumps to bump each dial on. A dial that is off stops the spark, one that is on lets it through, and only a spark that passes every dial lights the lamp. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change a monster's power.

box.tagline: Both dials on, or no light.
box.back: A small explorer in a red beanie finds a wire in the sky with dials on it. Bump each dial on, and the spark runs through to the lamp. Leave one off and the spark stops there. It is all monster power: the stronger monster wins and equal ones pass. Play, then open the game in Game-Maker and change a power.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
Monsters that meet compare power, which makes an AND
Made to be copied and taken apart
